Efficient Continuous Background Video Recorders for Windows 10
The landscape of continuous video recording tools for Windows 10 reveals several strong candidates for your requirements. Given your technical background and need for minimal resource usage with multi-camera support, here's a comprehensive analysis of the most suitable options:

Best Open-Source Solutions
VidGear
 (Python library) is particularly well-suited for your technical profile. It's a lightweight, multi-threaded Python wrapper around OpenCV that excels at handling multiple USB cameras simultaneously with minimal CPU overhead. Key strengths include:
​

Native multi-threading support for parallel camera streams

Compatible with NumPy for downstream processing

Excellent synchronization handling for multiple cameras

Minimal resource footprint compared to GUI-based solutions

Python-first design aligns with your development workflow

For a Python-based solution, VidGear's CamGear API directly supports multi-threaded USB camera capture, allowing you to record from separate devices in parallel by instantiating separate streams with thread management.
​
